title: At a Glance: 1, 2, 3

blocks.html: Some groups are so small you can see how many at once, without counting. Look! One. Two. Three. Your eyes just know.

blocks.name: pk-pic
blocks.cap: How many dots? Can you tell without counting?

blocks.html: You can see 1, 2 or 3 things at a glance.

For the grown-up: Hold up a hand with 1, 2 or 3 crackers and ask “How many?” right away. Quick looks build a feel for small numbers. Make it a game, not a test. Short and happy beats long. Five minutes is a good lesson.

items: Try it at home: Show 2 or 3 spoons for a second: how many?
Roll a die and say the number fast.
